name: Gulf Pipefish
lore: Passes for a blade of grass. Sips shrimp through a straw.
reference: Syngnathus scovelli: pencil-thin grass-green body ringed with dark armour plates, long tube snout, sand-tan belly, tiny fluttering dorsal fin and fan tail

notes.path: novel (slender_tube): candidates bucktooth parrotfish (struck: swimmer, failed beak), sheepshead (struck: swimmer, failed), dugong (struck: swimmer-adjacent torpedo), queen conch (struck: asymmetric spiral shell breaks bilateral contract), lined seahorse (struck: upright body breaks X-long axis) -> Gulf pipefish, a living seagrass blade

idle.personality: slow grass-blade sway, leaning with the current, dorsal fin buzzing like a tiny propeller

feed.technique: eases back and tucks its snout to aim, then flicks the head up and darts forward, two quick sips through the snout, little head bobs, slow settle

sulk.technique: a wilted blade: snout droops, body sags into a limp bow, dorsal fin barely ticks, pectorals clamped, sinks low, mouth corners down

rest.why: Gulf pipefish rest motionless on the bottom among seagrass bases, lying along the blades between slow hunting drifts.
